[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] '''Spenz''' was a minor [[Noble/Legends|aristocrat]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Soon after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Spenz hired [[Sic-Six/Legends|Sic-Six]] "[[Fanging|fanger]]" [[Trix-sor]], who had retired to enjoy gambling in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. Spenz wanted Trix-sor to keep track of the events in Cloud City and secretly report to him. The Imperial believed he could obtain greater power by making use of that information.
